commit.message:
research_baseline_sparse: name sparse-checkout omissions without touching pinned inputs (#3725)

* research_baseline: name sparse-checkout omissions instead of failing opaquely

portable-replay (verifier-engineering). In a sparse checkout the card's
positive control died with "Invalid selected file: .../ASSEMBLY.json" and no
hint which of 27 directories to materialize; at least five sessions recorded
that failure and stopped (#1594, #2690, #2253, #1317, PR #3628).

Before the strict check, enumerate the selected record's inputs (reading the
source manifest from HEAD if it is itself omitted) and apply the chooser's
PR3102 contract: stage-zero regular skip-worktree entries matching HEAD are
reported as SPARSE_SELECTED_INPUTS_ABSENT with the exact
`git sparse-checkout add` directories (exit 2). Deletions and drift still
fail as before; full checkouts are unchanged. verify_selected_result.py is
not modified.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* research_baseline_sparse: name sparse-checkout omissions without touching pinned inputs

Move the sparse-checkout diagnosis out of scripts/research_baseline.py and
tests/test_research_onboarding.py, which research packages pin as live
inputs, into a new preflight script and test module. Both pinned files are
restored to main's bytes, so no package replay is selected by this change.

scripts/research_baseline_sparse.py lists every input the selected-record
check reads, applies the PR3102 skip-worktree/HEAD contract via
choose_research_task.check_catalog_files (imported, unchanged), and prints
SPARSE_SELECTED_INPUTS_ABSENT with the git sparse-checkout add command
(exit 2), or NO_SPARSE_SELECTED_OMISSIONS (exit 0). Ordinary deletions and
staged index drift still raise "Invalid selected file".

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Name the selected inputs a sparse checkout omits before research_baseline.py.
+
+In a sparse checkout, ``scripts/research_baseline.py`` stops at the first absent
+selected input with ``Invalid selected file: ...`` and does not say which
+directories it needs. This read-only preflight lists every input that check
+reads and prints the ``git sparse-checkout add`` command that materializes them.
+
+An absent path counts as a sparse omission only under the chooser's PR3102
+contract (``choose_research_task.check_catalog_files``): a stage-zero regular
+skip-worktree entry whose blob matches HEAD. An ordinary deletion, staged drift
+or unknown path raises the same ``Invalid selected file`` error. Byte drift in
+present files is left to ``research_baseline.py``. Nothing is verified here.
+
+This is a separate script so that the baseline and its tests, which research
+packages pin as live inputs, keep their bytes.
+
+Exit codes: 0 when no selected input is omitted, 2 when some are.
+
+Douglas Colkitt, with Claude Opus 5.5 assistance. Apache-2.0. The sparse
+contract follows Arham-Tahir64's PR3102.
+"""
+import argparse
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+from choose_research_task import check_catalog_files
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+SELECTED = "certificates/selected-result.json"
+
+
+def selected_inputs(record, root=ROOT):
+    """Repository paths the selected-record check reads, before it reads them."""
+    names = [record["certificate"], record["source_manifest"], record["proof"],
+             record["review"], record["validation"], *record["proof_supplements"]]
+    check_catalog_files(root, [(names[1], "Invalid selected file: " + names[1])])
+    manifest = root / record["source_manifest"]
+    if manifest.is_file():
+        raw = manifest.read_bytes()
+    else:  # a sparse omission whose index blob matches HEAD (checked above)
+        raw = subprocess.run(["git", "cat-file", "blob", "HEAD:" + record["source_manifest"]],
+                             cwd=root, check=True, capture_output=True).stdout
+    inventory = json.loads(raw)
+    if inventory.get("format") == "repository-packages-sha256-v1":
+        names += inventory["files"]
+    else:
+        parent = Path(record["source_manifest"]).parent
+        names += [(parent / name).as_posix() for name in inventory["files"]]
+    return sorted(set(names))
+
+
+def sparse_omissions(record, root=ROOT):
+    """Selected inputs absent only because this is a sparse checkout."""
+    names = selected_inputs(record, root)
+    return check_catalog_files(root, [(name, "Invalid selected file: " + name) for name in names])
+
+
+def materialize_command(omitted):
+    """Cone-mode directories covering the omitted files (one research package each)."""
+    dirs = set()
+    for name in omitted:
+        parts = name.split("/")
+        if parts[0] == "research" and len(parts) > 2:
+            dirs.add("/".join(parts[:2]))
+        else:
+            dirs.add("/".join(parts[:-1]) or ".")
+    return ["git", "sparse-checkout", "add", *sorted(dirs)]
+
+
+def report(record, root=ROOT):
+    omitted = sparse_omissions(record, root)
+    if not omitted:
+        return 0, {
+            "status": "NO_SPARSE_SELECTED_OMISSIONS",
+            "next": ["python3", "-B", "scripts/research_baseline.py"],
+            "scope": "Every selected input is present. Nothing was verified; run the baseline next.",
+        }
+    return 2, {
+        "status": "SPARSE_SELECTED_INPUTS_ABSENT",
+        "omitted_files": len(omitted), "first_omitted": omitted[:5],
+        "materialize": materialize_command(omitted),
+        "scope": "This sparse checkout omits selected inputs (skip-worktree entries matching HEAD). "
+                 "Run the materialize command, then scripts/research_baseline.py; nothing was verified.",
+    }
+
+
+def main(argv=None):
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n\n")[0])
+    ap.add_argument("--root", type=Path, default=ROOT, help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
+    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
+    record = json.loads((args.root / SELECTED).read_bytes())
+    code, result = report(record, args.root)
+    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
+    return code
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

@@ -0,0 +1,115 @@
+"""The sparse preflight names omitted selected inputs instead of failing opaquely."""
+import contextlib
+import io
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
+import research_baseline_sparse as sparse
+sys.path.pop(0)
+
+RECORD = {
+    "certificate": "research/audit/ASSEMBLY.json", "source_manifest": "research/audit/SOURCE.json",
+    "proof": "research/pkg-a/PROOF.md", "review": "docs/review.md",
+    "validation": "docs/validation.md",
+    "proof_supplements": {"research/pkg-b/NOTE.md": "0", "scripts/helper.py": "0"},
+}
+
+
+class SparseBaselineTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
+        self.addCleanup(temporary.cleanup)
+        self.root = Path(temporary.name)
+        files = {
+            "certificates/selected-result.json": json.dumps(RECORD),
+            "docs/review.md": "review\n", "docs/validation.md": "validation\n",
+            "scripts/helper.py": "pass\n", "research/pkg-a/PROOF.md": "proof\n",
+            "research/pkg-a/data/x.json": "[]\n", "research/pkg-b/NOTE.md": "note\n",
+            "research/audit/ASSEMBLY.json": "{}\n",
+            "research/audit/SOURCE.json": json.dumps({
+                "format": "repository-packages-sha256-v1", "package_roots": ["research/pkg-a"],
+                "files": {"research/pkg-a/PROOF.md": "0", "research/pkg-a/data/x.json": "0"}}),
+        }
+        for name, body in files.items():
+            path = self.root / name
+            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+            path.write_text(body, encoding="utf-8")
+        self.record = RECORD
+        self.git("init", "-q")
+        self.git("add", ".")
+        self.commit("fixture")
+
+    def git(self, *args):
+        return subprocess.run(["git", *args], cwd=self.root, check=True, capture_output=True,
+                              text=True, encoding="utf-8").stdout
+
+    def commit(self, message, *extra):
+        self.git("-c", "user.name=Fixture", "-c", "user.email=fixture@example.invalid",
+                 "-c", "core.hooksPath=/dev/null", "commit", "-q", *extra, "-m", message)
+
+    def run_main(self):
+        out = io.StringIO()
+        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out):
+            code = sparse.main(["--root", str(self.root)])
+        return code, json.loads(out.getvalue())
+
+    def test_full_checkout_reports_nothing(self):
+        self.assertEqual(sparse.sparse_omissions(self.record, self.root), [])
+        code, result = self.run_main()
+        self.assertEqual((code, result["status"]), (0, "NO_SPARSE_SELECTED_OMISSIONS"))
+
+    def test_cone_sparse_names_packages_and_reads_manifest_from_head(self):
+        self.git("sparse-checkout", "set", "--cone", "scripts", "docs", "certificates")
+        self.assertFalse((self.root / "research/audit/SOURCE.json").exists())
+        omitted = sparse.sparse_omissions(self.record, self.root)
+        self.assertEqual(omitted, ["research/audit/ASSEMBLY.json", "research/audit/SOURCE.json",
+                                   "research/pkg-a/PROOF.md", "research/pkg-a/data/x.json",
+                                   "research/pkg-b/NOTE.md"])
+        code, result = self.run_main()
+        self.assertEqual((code, result["status"], result["omitted_files"]),
+                         (2, "SPARSE_SELECTED_INPUTS_ABSENT", 5))
+        command = result["materialize"]
+        self.assertEqual(command, sparse.materialize_command(omitted))
+        self.assertEqual(command[3:], ["research/audit", "research/pkg-a", "research/pkg-b"])
+        self.git(*command[1:])
+        self.assertEqual(sparse.sparse_omissions(self.record, self.root), [])
+        self.assertEqual(self.run_main()[0], 0)
+
+    def test_non_cone_sparse_and_legacy_package_relative_manifest(self):
+        legacy = self.root / "research/audit/SOURCE.json"
+        legacy.write_text(json.dumps({"files": {"ASSEMBLY.json": "0"}}), encoding="utf-8")
+        self.commit("legacy", "-a")
+        self.git("sparse-checkout", "set", "--no-cone", "/scripts/", "/docs/", "/certificates/",
+                 "/research/pkg-a/", "/research/pkg-b/")
+        self.assertEqual(sparse.sparse_omissions(self.record, self.root),
+                         ["research/audit/ASSEMBLY.json", "research/audit/SOURCE.json"])
+
+    def test_ordinary_deletion_is_not_reported_as_sparse(self):
+        (self.root / "research/pkg-a/data/x.json").unlink()
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Invalid selected file: research/pkg-a/data/x.json"):
+            sparse.sparse_omissions(self.record, self.root)
+        self.git("checkout", "--", "research/pkg-a/data/x.json")
+        self.git("sparse-checkout", "set", "--cone", "scripts", "docs", "certificates", "research/audit")
+        (self.root / "research/audit/SOURCE.json").unlink()
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Invalid selected file: research/audit/SOURCE.json"):
+            sparse.sparse_omissions(self.record, self.root)
+
+    def test_staged_change_to_omitted_entry_is_not_sparse(self):
+        self.git("sparse-checkout", "set", "--cone", "scripts", "docs", "certificates",
+                 "research/audit", "research/pkg-a")
+        changed = subprocess.run(["git", "hash-object", "-w", "--stdin"], cwd=self.root, input="other\n",
+                                 check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
+        self.git("update-index", "--cacheinfo", "100644," + changed + ",research/pkg-b/NOTE.md")
+        self.git("update-index", "--skip-worktree", "research/pkg-b/NOTE.md")
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Invalid selected file: research/pkg-b/NOTE.md"):
+            sparse.sparse_omissions(self.record, self.root)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
